chunks: Bahr al-Saqqa' narrated from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
"Indeed, among the comfort and mercy from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, are three things: tahajjud in the night, the breaking of the fast of the fasting person, and meeting with the brothers."

key_terms.إِفْطَارَ: breaking the fast at the end of the fasting period
key_terms.التَّهَجُّدَ: night prayer performed in the late hours of the night
key_terms.رَوْحِ: comfort, relief, and mercy from Allah in this context
key_terms.لِقَاءَ: meeting and coming together with others

ai.seo_question: What things are counted among the comfort and mercy from Allah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies three sources of divine comfort and relief: night worship, iftar after fasting, and fellowship with fellow believers. It highlights the spiritual sweetness found in devotion, worship, and righteous companionship.
